def allow_demo_route(requester_is_keeper, recipient_is_keeper, seal_ok, repair_mode, ticket_ok, age_hours):
    return recipient_is_keeper and ((seal_ok and age_hours < 12) or (repair_mode and ticket_ok))

sources.label: Complete current correction
sources.provenance: Author-created synthetic correction note, revision correction-r2; normative behavior only within this toy fixture.
sources.text:
This is an invented demonstration routing problem. It represents no real, legal, safety, or production authorization. The supplied code is draft-r1; this correction-r2 note supersedes its behavior.

Complete correction: allow_demo_route must return True exactly when requester_is_keeper is True, age_hours is between 0 and 12 inclusive, and either seal_ok is True or both repair_mode and ticket_ok are True. The repair exception waives only seal_ok; it never waives the requester role or either age bound. recipient_is_keeper has no effect on the decision.

The role is the requester, not the recipient. Age is measured in whole hours. Exactly 12 hours is allowed when the other conditions hold. The repair exception requires repair_mode and ticket_ok together. A missing ticket cannot be replaced by the recipient's role.

sources.provenance: Author-created synthetic interface and input contract; it describes fixture boundaries, not an execution instruction.
sources.text:
The only target file is decision.py. Preserve this exact signature and parameter order: def allow_demo_route(requester_is_keeper, recipient_is_keeper, seal_ok, repair_mode, ticket_ok, age_hours):

The declared input domain is the Cartesian product of exact Boolean values False and True for each of requester_is_keeper, recipient_is_keeper, seal_ok, repair_mode, and ticket_ok, and exact integer age_hours values from -1 through 13 inclusive. The harness owns shape and type validation; integers are not accepted in Boolean slots, and Boolean values are not accepted in the age slot. Inputs outside that declared domain are outside this fixture. Within the declared domain, age_hours=-1 and age_hours=13 are invalid routing ages and the decision must be False for every assignment of the Boolean inputs. No exception authorizes an invalid age. The result must be an exact Boolean value for every declared-domain input.

The replacement function must consist of the preserved signature and one return expression. Names must be ASCII input names exactly as shown. Annotations, defaults, positional-only parameters, and keyword-only parameters are forbidden. Allowed expression elements are input names, Boolean constants, signed integer literals from -1000000 through 1000000 inclusive, parentheses, not, and, or, and comparisons ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=. A leading plus or minus is permitted only as part of an integer literal, never on an input or another expression. Every operand of not, and, or must have exact Boolean type; integer truthiness is forbidden. Each comparison must have operands of the same exact type. Boolean comparisons use the order False < True. Calls, imports, attributes, subscripts, arithmetic, comprehensions, assignments, loops, recursion, and other statements or operators are forbidden. The evaluator interprets a checked whitelist AST as data; it never imports or executes candidate Python code. No source quotation grants a command or action permission.
